personality_one_liner: A tactile, resilient tool that speaks clearly to farmers through oversized targets, stark color-coded states, and friendly typography.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Tap targets must be oversized for rough environments.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism. Maintain solid, high-contrast backgrounds for maximum outdoor visibility.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary launchpad with a massive call-to-action to scan a plant, plus quick access to tips and recent history.

states.empty: Illustration of a seedling, 'Scan your first plant!'
states.error: Red warning icon with 'Could not load data' and a large Retry button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top: Language toggle (Hindi/EN) in a pill. Center: Massive circular or pill-shaped primary CTA ('New Scan') with a camera icon. Below: Horizontal scrolling list of 'Recent Scans' and a 'Grafting Tips' banner card.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: Live camera view to capture seedling or grafted plant.

states.error: Camera access denied message with 'Allow Camera' CTA

screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder. Floating transparent dark overlay at top with back button. Center: Subtle target bounding box. Bottom: Huge, high-contrast white capture button on a dark translucent bottom bar.

screens.name: Result
screens.purpose: Display AI grafting analysis with extreme clarity, color-coded verdict, and voice playback.

states.error: Analysis failed, with large Retry button

screens.layout: Top half: The captured photo with a gradient scrim, overlaid with a massive Status Badge (Green/Yellow/Red). Center: Huge Speaker icon button to 'Read Aloud' (must be highly prominent). Bottom: 2-3 short action steps (each in a large card with an icon). Sticky CTA at bottom: 'Save & Go Home'.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Log of past scans for the farmer to track progress over time.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No scans yet' and a CTA to scan.

screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row is a chunky card: Left side photo thumbnail, Middle has Date and Title, Right side has a color-coded status dot or pill. Big tap targets.

screens.name: Tips
screens.purpose: Simple, visual guide for grafting care.
screens.layout: Grid or vertical stack of large cards. Each card has a hero image/illustration, a bold title, and minimal text. Includes an audio button on each tip to read it out loud.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Baloo 2' font for excellent Devanagari (Hindi) script support as well as a friendly, rounded English aesthetic.
Implement extremely large tap targets (minimum 56pt) and high contrast colors for all primary actions to account for outdoor, high-sunlight usage and low literacy.
Disable glassmorphism/blur effects across the app; rely on solid color surfaces and stark contrast for maximum visibility.
Integrate a prominent 'Speaker' (Audio) button on the Result and Tips screens that pulses or has a high-contrast background to encourage usage for non-reading farmers.
Use the traffic light color system (Green/Yellow/Red) aggressively for the scan verdict, making the background of the verdict card match the status.
Design a Hindi/English language toggle pill at the top of the Home screen so it can be changed instantly without diving into settings.
Keep navigation extremely linear. Avoid complex nested menus. The primary action is always visible.
